# OSPFv3 LSA (`ospfv3_lsa`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 20 octets (fixed)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ospfv3_lsu`](ospfv3_lsu.md) | `num_lsas` | (any other value) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ls_age` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | Time since the LSA was originated, in seconds (keep 0 for an exact Auto checksum). |
| `ls_type` | `enum(16)` | `8193` (router) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | LSA function code with U / S scope bits (Auto from the LSA body layer). |
| `link_state_id` | `uint(32)` | `0` |   | Link State ID identifying the described part of the network. |
| `advertising_router` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.1` |   | Router ID of the router that originated the LSA. |
| `ls_sequence` | `uint(32)` | `2147483649` |   | LSA sequence number (0x80000001 = initial). |
| `ls_checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Fletcher checksum over the header and everything after it; `ls_age` counted as zero | Fletcher checksum of the LSA without LS age (Auto). |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets | Length of the LSA including its header, in octets (Auto). |

### `ls_type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 8193 (0x2001) | `router` |
| 8194 (0x2002) | `network` |
| 8195 (0x2003) | `inter_area_prefix` |
| 8196 (0x2004) | `inter_area_router` |
| 16389 (0x4005) | `as_external` |
| 8199 (0x2007) | `nssa` |
| 8 (0x0008) | `link` |
| 8201 (0x2009) | `intra_area_prefix` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `ls_type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 8193 (0x2001) | [`ospfv3_router_lsa`](ospfv3_router_lsa.md) |   |
| 8194 (0x2002) | [`ospfv3_network_lsa`](ospfv3_network_lsa.md) |   |
| 8195 (0x2003) | [`ospfv3_inter_area_prefix_lsa`](ospfv3_inter_area_prefix_lsa.md) |   |
| 16389 (0x4005) | [`ospfv3_as_external_lsa`](ospfv3_as_external_lsa.md) |   |
| 8199 (0x2007) | [`ospfv3_as_external_lsa`](ospfv3_as_external_lsa.md) |   |
| 8 (0x0008) | [`ospfv3_link_lsa`](ospfv3_link_lsa.md) |   |
| 8201 (0x2009) | [`ospfv3_intra_area_prefix_lsa`](ospfv3_intra_area_prefix_lsa.md) |   |
